children: The World Cup was a net negative for Darden Restaurants, CFO Raj Vennam says on a call with analysts. The company's Olive Garden and LongHorn Steakhouse brands aren't really restaurants that people go to watch sporting events, and as a result, traffic trends took a hit. There was one bright spot, though. Darden's Yard House banner--which serves classic American fare and has over a hundred beers on tap--is a natural gathering place for sporting events, CEO Rick Cardenas says. Yard House's same-restaurant sales climbed 10% during the recent quarter. Darden is off 2.3% in early trading.. (connor.hart@wsj.com)
